questions.text:
He's out on a run and his phone is just sitting on the couch. 😔
For three months he's been grinning at that thing and walking out of the room when I look over.
I get to bed around two after my shift and I can still hear him typing.
Who is Jonah texting late at night after I go to bed?

Ten years, and I've never once heard that name.
Last night he texted me he was stuck finishing paperwork at the clinic.
I got home at one and his car wasn't in the lot.
Where exactly did Jonah drive after work last night?

He can't cut an onion. Who is he trying to impress? 😔
Last week Lena kissed me hello on the cheek and wouldn't look me in the eye.
If they're hiding something, one of them is coaching the other.
What does Lena keep telling Jonah not to do?
questions.hint: Open WhatsApp and find the one-on-one chat where the same warning comes up more than once.

onboarding.text: I got off the line at one in the morning and Jonah's car wasn't in the lot. Again. Three months of late nights and half answers, and him grinning at his phone like a teenager.

onboarding.text: We met at freshman orientation, two broke kids who couldn't find the dining hall. Ten years later we still split rent, groceries and every bad decision. He's my brother in everything but blood.

onboarding.text: Jonah Pike, physical therapist. Fixes everybody's shoulders, never talks about his own stuff. Gym, early runs, a hundred photos of his mom's beagle. He's the guy you call at 3 AM. Lately he doesn't pick up.
